definitions.gloss: last time, previous occasion, previous time
definitions.explanation: Refers to the previous instance of a recurring event or action. Commonly used as an adverbial noun (without a particle) to mean 'last time.'

examples.japanese: {前回|ぜんかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{前回|ぜんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}しよう→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Let's confirm what was decided at the last meeting.

examples.japanese: {前回|ぜんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: My grades improved compared to the last exam.

notes:
Functions as an adverbial noun — can modify a sentence directly without a particle ({前回|ぜんかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ or just {前回|ぜんかい} at the start of a clause). Pairs naturally with ⟦{次回|じかい}→次回：13170_jikai⟧ (next time) and ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧ (this time).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前回|ぜんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ — last time's results
- {前回|ぜんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反省|はんせい}→反省：03570_hansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧ — to learn from last time's mistakes
- {前回|ぜんかい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧ — compared to last time
- {前回|ぜんかい}⟦{同様|どうよう}→同様：01654_douyou⟧ — same as last time
